SCHOOLBOY KIDNAPPED. O.C.I.

At 10.35a.m. 26/9/40, Mr. J.R. Norton of St.
John's University Senior Middle School, Jessfield
Road, came to this station, and reported that one
of his students, named

Chen Cheng Tsung ( 陈崇正 ), 18,
Chekiang, student, St. John's
University Senior Middle School,
son of Mr. Chen Iung ( 陈英 ),
accountant, employed by Siemssen
& Co., 451 Kiangse Road, 849/140
Seymour Road. Wearing rimless
spectacles, short sighted.
Dressed in black jacket, brown
trousers, rubber shoes. Speaks
English.

had been kidnapped by armed men on Jessfield Road
near the School.

Mr. Norton said he had first received information
of the affair when at about 8.45a.m. 26/9/40, the boy's
ricksha coolie, accompanied by a relative, came to the
school, and reported the matter.

The following has now been ascertained:-

At about 7.15a.m. 26/9/40, the kidnapped boy
left his home bound for school. He travelled in his
father's private ricksha licence No. 7664 pulled by
Tang Sung Woo ( 唐生和 ), s/ricksha coolie, permit
No. 7296.

The ricksha arrived within about 300 yards east

1940年9月26日。

杂项编号 633/40。

1.

学生遭绑架案。情报主任。

1940年9月26日上午10时35分，极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）圣约翰大学附属高中教员 J.R. Norton 先生来到本警署报案，称其一名学生

陈崇正（Chen Cheng Tsung），18岁，
浙江籍，圣约翰大学附属高中学生，
系陈英（Chen Iung）先生之子，
陈英为会计师，受雇于江西路451号
西门子洋行（Siemssen & Co.），住西摩路849弄140号。
戴无框眼镜，近视。
身穿黑色上衣、棕色长裤、胶鞋。
会说英语。

在学校附近的极司菲尔路上被持械男子绑架。

Norton 先生称，他最初获悉此事是在1940年9月26日上午约8时45分，当时该生的黄包车夫由一名亲属陪同来到学校，报告了此事。

现已查明情况如下：

1940年9月26日上午约7时15分，被绑男孩离开家前往学校。他乘坐其父亲的私人黄包车（执照号码 7664），车夫为唐生和（Tang Sung Woo），二级黄包车夫，许可证号码 7296。

黄包车行至距极司菲尔路学校以东约300码处时，

page_data.en:
Misc.No. 633/40.

1/2.

of the school on Jessfield Road, when at about 7.45
a.m. 26/3/40, a gang of about six men, two of them
armed with small pistols, suddenly appeared on the
roadway pulled the boy out of the ricsha, and drag-
ged him into a nearby lane.
The gang told the ricsha coolie to return home,
and say nothing of the incident.
The ricsha coolie returned home as fast as
possible, and at once informed the household of the
occurrence. Then, the ricsha coolie, accompanied
by Mr. Tsang Zung (張禎), uncle of the kidnap-
ped boy, went to the school and reported the affair.
Prior to the recent tramway strike, the boy
was taken only as far as the corner of Ferry and
Sinsa Roads by the ricsha coolie, and from there
he travelled alone by railless tramcar to Jessfield
Park. He completed the journey by walking across
the Park to the school gates.
Mr. Chen Iung, father of the kidnapped boy,
was called to this station. He can give no
reason whatsoever for the affair. He said he is
not a wealthy person, and has no activities outside
of his office.
Photographs of the kidnapped boy have been
supplied.
page_data.zh:
杂项编号 633/40。

1/2.

即在1940年3月26日（原文如此，应为9月）上午约7时45分，一伙约六名男子突然出现在马路上，其中两人持有小型手枪，将男孩从黄包车上拉下，拖入附近的一条弄堂。
这伙人命令黄包车夫回家，且不得提及此事。
黄包车夫尽快赶回家中，立即向家属通报了发生的情况。随后，黄包车夫在被绑男孩的叔叔张禎（Mr. Tsang Zung）陪同下，前往学校报告此事。
在最近的电车罢工之前，该男孩仅由黄包车夫送至渡船路（Ferry Road）与新闸路（Sinsa Road）转角处，然后独自乘坐无轨电车前往极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）。最后步行穿过公园到达学校门口。
被绑男孩的父亲陈英（Chen Iung）先生已被传唤至本警署。他对事发原因完全无法提供解释。他表示自己并非富人，除办公室工作外无任何其他活动。
已提供被绑男孩的照片。

Misc.No. 633/40.
1/3.

The description of the gang, as given by the
ricsha coolie, is:-

(1) Age about 30, height about 5'6",
medium build, dark complexion,
long face, long hair combed back,
wearing grey cloth jacket and
pants, speaking Kompo dialect.

(2) Age about 25, height about 5'4",
medium build, dark complexion,
round face, wearing black cloth
jacket and pants, speaking Kompo
dialect.

(3), (4), (5) & (6) description not
available.

Circulated.

S.C.C.Police Bureau informed.

AB Crumfield
D. S. O 37.

据黄包车夫描述，该伙歹徒的特征如下：

(1) 年龄约30岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，
中等身材，肤色黝黑，
长脸，长发向后梳理，
身穿灰色布制上衣和裤子，
讲宁波话（Kompo dialect）。

(2) 年龄约25岁，身高约5英尺4英寸，
中等身材，肤色黝黑，
圆脸，身穿黑色布制上衣和裤子，
讲宁波话（Kompo dialect）。

(3)、(4)、(5) 及 (6) 无特征描述。

已分发通报。

已通知上海特别市警察局（S.C.C. Police Bureau）。

AB Crumfield
